summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by RedHill Biopharma Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the closing of a private placement. The company issued 8,571,429 ADSs along with series A-1 and A-2 warrants to purchase the same number of ADSs, at a combined price of $0.70 per ADS/unit, raising $6 million upfront. Proceeds will support a potential acquisition of commercial-stage pharma assets, but no definitive agreement exists. H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent. The filing is an ordinary securities issuance, not a special situation.
